summary: This bill amends the Public Health Service Act to require health plans and insurers to cover prostate cancer screenings without cost-sharing for men aged 40 and older who are at high risk, including African-American men and those with a family history of prostate cancer.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates that health insurance plans cover prostate cancer screenings for high-risk men without cost-sharing. This expands access to preventive healthcare services, aligning with a more public healthcare approach by increasing covered benefits and reducing out-of-pocket costs for specific services.
